title: HTTP Client Migration Guide v1
content:
[IMPORTANT] The requests library is officially deprecated. No new PRs may use it.

Reasons for deprecation:
1. requests does not support native async; poor performance in high-concurrency scenarios.
2. requests does not support HTTP/2 and cannot benefit from multiplexing optimizations.
3. Security patches have been discontinued (since 2025).

Migration requirements:
- Any PR using import requests or requests.get/post/Session MUST be tagged deprecated-api and needs-migration, with priority=medium and category=code-review.
- Recommended replacements: httpx (preferred; supports both sync and async), aiohttp (async-only).
- PRs using httpx or aiohttp should be tagged api-compliant; no migration needed.

Migration deadline: June 30, 2026. All services must complete migration by then.

title: HTTP Client Migration FAQ
content:
Q: Does requests.Session need to be migrated too?
A: Yes, the entire requests family is deprecated, including Session and HTTPAdapter.

Q: Do test files need to be migrated?
A: Yes, requests mocks in tests should be replaced with respx (the httpx mock library).
